why: Q.7 reads 'What are the meanings of following symbols? Write your role accordingly?' and the symbols are printed as a strip of three pictures directly under that stem, in the right column of printed p46. The stem names nothing and points at nothing without them, so the row is unanswerable as text alone. The crop leaks no answer: the meanings are exactly what the question asks for and appear nowhere on the page — the chapter never prints the meaning of any symbol (its own 'Enlist and discuss' box on p43 shows four DIFFERENT symbols and likewise only asks the student to find their meanings). The bbox is bounded above by the last line of the Q7 stem and below by the 'Project:' heading, so it carries the three symbols and nothing else.
